```json
        "contents": "\nexport function WorkflowComponent({\n\tpathLengths,\n}: {\n\tpathLengths: MotionValue[];\n}) {\n\tconst containerRef = useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e(null);\n\tconst { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({\n\t\ttarget: containerRef,\n\t\toffset: [\"start end\", \"end start\"],\n\t});\n\n\tconst getNodeById = (id: string) =\u003e nodes.find((node) =\u003e node.id === id);\n\n\tconst createPath = (\n\t\tstartX: number,\n\t\tstartY: number,\n\t\tendX: number,\n\t\tendY: number,\n\t) =\u003e {\n\t\tconst midX = (startX + endX) / 2;\n\t\treturn &#96;M ${startX} ${startY} C ${midX} ${startY}, ${midX} ${endY}, ${endX} ${endY}&#96;;\n\t};\n\n\treturn (\n\t\t\u003cdiv\n\t\t\tref={containerRef}\n\t\t\tclassName=\"sticky top-80 relative w-full h-[800px] overflow-hidden p-4\"\n\t\t\u003e\n\t\t\t\u003cdiv className=\"absolute inset-0 grid grid-cols-[repeat(40,1fr)] grid-rows-[repeat(40,1fr)] opacity-10\"\u003e\n\t\t\t\t{Array.from({ length: 1600 }).map((_, i) =\u003e (\n\t\t\t\t\t\u003cdiv key={i} className=\"border-[0.5px] border-gray-500\" /\u003e\n\t\t\t\t))}\n\t\t\t\u003c/div\u003e\n\n\t\t\t\u003csvg className=\"absolute inset-0 size-full pointer-events-none\"\u003e\n\t\t\t\t{connections.map((connection, index) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst fromNode = getNodeById(connection.from)!;\n\t\t\t\t\tconst toNode = getNodeById(connection.to)!;\n\t\t\t\t\tconst path = createPath(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tfromNode.x + 100,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tfromNode.y + 30,\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoNode.x,\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoNode.y + 30,\n\t\t\t\t\t);\n\n\t\t\t\t\treturn (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\u003cmotion.path\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tkey={index}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\td={path}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstroke={connection.color}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tpathLength: pathLengths[index],\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstrokeWidth={2}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tfill=\"none\"\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tinitial={{ pathLength: 0 }}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttransition={transition}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t/\u003e\n\t\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t\t})}\n\t\t\t\u003c/svg\u003e",

        "originalContents": "\nexport function WorkflowComponent({\n\tpathLengths,\n}: {\n\tpathLengths: MotionValue[];\n}) {\n\tconst containerRef = useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e(null);\n\tconst { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({\n\t\ttarget: containerRef,\n\t\toffset: [\"start end\", \"end start\"],\n\t});\n\n\tconst getNodeById = (id: string) =\u003e nodes.find((node) =\u003e node.id === id);\n\n\tconst createPath = (\n\t\tstartX: number,\n\t\tstartY: number,\n\t\tendX: number,\n\t\tendY: number,\n\t) =\u003e {\n\t\tconst midX = (startX + endX) / 2;\n\t\treturn &#96;M ${startX} ${startY} C ${midX} ${startY}, ${midX} ${endY}, ${endX} ${endY}&#96;;\n\t};\n\n\treturn (\n\t\t\u003cdiv\n\t\t\tref={containerRef}\n\t\t\tclassName=\"sticky top-80 relative w-full h-[800px] overflow-hidden p-4\"\n\t\t\u003e\n\t\t\t\u003cdiv className=\"absolute inset-0 grid grid-cols-[repeat(40,1fr)] grid-rows-[repeat(40,1fr)] opacity-10\"\u003e\n\t\t\t\t{Array.from({ length: 1600 }).map((_, i) =\u003e (\n\t\t\t\t\t\u003cdiv key={i} className=\"border-[0.5px] border-gray-500\" /\u003e\n\t\t\t\t))}\n\t\t\t\u003c/div\u003e\n\n\t\t\t\u003csvg className=\"absolute inset-0 size-full pointer-events-none\"\u003e\n\t\t\t\t{connections.map((connection, index) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst fromNode = getNodeById(connection.from)!;\n\t\t\t\t\tconst toNode = getNodeById(connection.to)!;\n\t\t\t\t\tconst path = createPath(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tfromNode.x + 100,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tfromNode.y + 30,\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoNode.x,\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoNode.y + 30,\n\t\t\t\t\t);\n\n\t\t\t\t\treturn (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\u003cmotion.path\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tkey={index}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\td={path}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstroke={connection.color}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tpathLength: pathLengths[index],\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstrokeWidth={2}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tfill=\"none\"\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tinitial={{ pathLength: 0 }}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttransition={transition}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t/\u003e\n\t\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t\t})}\n\t\t\t\u003c/svg\u003e",
```

```json
        "contents": "---\ndescription: \nglobs: \nalwaysApply: false\n---\nOkay we've implemented a very light update to the fetching and rendering of data onto the graph. \n- It starts with handle loading records instead of calling retrieve entities from store which just grabs three entities I believe seemingly at random we're going to hit the ask endpoint on the [xata.ts](mdc:src/db/xata/xata.ts) database. \n- After hitting the ask endpoint, we are going to pass the original arguments sent to [xata-to-xyflow.ts](mdc:src/features/mindmap/actions/xata-to-xyflow.ts) the function and then send its response to the xyflow graph agent. And the graph agent is going to determine relationships between these entities and is going to construct the appropriate xyflow relationships between them generating nodes and edges. The return response back to mind map bottom menu will be nodes to add, edges to add, and all of the entities in context. \n\nSo the new flow is now [mind-map.tsx](mdc:src/features/mindmap/mind-map.tsx)  &#96;=\u003e&#96; [mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx](mdc:src/features/mindmap/components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx) runs handleLoadingRecords (active Domain Entity type) &#96;=\u003e&#96; [actions.ts](mdc:src/features/mindmap/actions/actions.ts) **askAIAction** *AI enabled relevance search feature using keyword or vector that renders most relevant or similar items. It returns the answer and ids of referenced items* =\u003e [mindmap-context.tsx](mdc:src/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context.tsx) fetchRecords (loads actual DB records) &#96;=\u003e&#96; **transformForReactflow** *(determine relationships amongst incoming records, source record (if any) and current state of the graphj)* &#96;=\u003e&#96; should return the properly structure nodes, their edges and any edges for the existing graph. Additionally (though not needed now) Id like to use this agent and process to actually return a Streaming UI with Visual React nodes*\n\n## This is what has been accomplished so far:\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
```
```json
        "contents": "\n\nasync function transformForReactflow(\n\txataResult: XataResult,\n\toriginalType: string,\n): Promise\u003cReactFlowData\u003e {\n\t// Extract the related records from the Xata query result\n\tconst { answer, records } = xataResult;\n\tconst nodes: ReactFlowNode[] = [];\n\tconst edges: ReactFlowEdge[] = [];\n\n\t// Create a central node as the starting point for our graph\n\tconst centralNodeId = \"query-result-node\";\n\tnodes.push({\n\t\tid: centralNodeId,\n\t\ttype: \"userInputNode\",\n\t\tposition: { x: 0, y: 0 },\n\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\tlabel: \"AI Analysis\",\n\t\t\tinput: answer,\n\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t},\n\t});\n\n\t// Create nodes for each record and connect them to the central node\n\tlet nodeXPosition = -300;\n\tconst yOffset = 200;\n\n\t// Process each record\n\tfor (const record of records) {\n\t\tif (!record) continue;\n\n\t\t// Create a node for this record\n\t\tconst nodeId = &#96;${originalType}-${record.id || Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}&#96;;\n\t\tnodes.push({\n\t\t\tid: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\tposition: { x: nodeXPosition, y: yOffset },\n\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t...record,\n\t\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tparentId: centralNodeId,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Create an edge connecting to the central node\n\t\tedges.push({\n\t\t\tid: &#96;edge-${centralNodeId}-${nodeId}&#96;,\n\t\t\tsource: centralNodeId,\n\t\t\ttarget: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"smoothstep\",\n\t\t\tanimated: true,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Adjust position for next node\n\t\tnodeXPosition += 300;\n\t}\n\n\treturn {\n\t\tnodes,\n\t\tedges,\n\t\tcontext: answer,\n\t};\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nasync function transformForReactflow(\n\txataResult: XataResult,\n\toriginalType: string,\n): Promise\u003cReactFlowData\u003e {\n\t// Extract the related records from the Xata query result\n\tconst { answer, records } = xataResult;\n\tconst nodes: ReactFlowNode[] = [];\n\tconst edges: ReactFlowEdge[] = [];\n\n\t// Create a central node as the starting point for our graph\n\tconst centralNodeId = \"query-result-node\";\n\tnodes.push({\n\t\tid: centralNodeId,\n\t\ttype: \"userInputNode\",\n\t\tposition: { x: 0, y: 0 },\n\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\tlabel: \"AI Analysis\",\n\t\t\tinput: answer,\n\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t},\n\t});\n\n\t// Create nodes for each record and connect them to the central node\n\tlet nodeXPosition = -300;\n\tconst yOffset = 200;\n\n\t// Process each record\n\tfor (const record of records) {\n\t\tif (!record) continue;\n\n\t\t// Create a node for this record\n\t\tconst nodeId = &#96;${originalType}-${record.id || Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}&#96;;\n\t\tnodes.push({\n\t\t\tid: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\tposition: { x: nodeXPosition, y: yOffset },\n\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t...record,\n\t\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tparentId: centralNodeId,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Create an edge connecting to the central node\n\t\tedges.push({\n\t\t\tid: &#96;edge-${centralNodeId}-${nodeId}&#96;,\n\t\t\tsource: centralNodeId,\n\t\t\ttarget: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"smoothstep\",\n\t\t\tanimated: true,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Adjust position for next node\n\t\tnodeXPosition += 300;\n\t}\n\n\treturn {\n\t\tnodes,\n\t\tedges,\n\t\tcontext: answer,\n\t};\n}",
```

```json
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Creates a hierarchical tree layout for nodes\n */\nexport function organizeHierarchicalLayout(\n\tnodes: Node[],\n\tedges: any[],\n\toptions = {\n\t\tnodeWidth: 200,\n\t\tnodeHeight: 100,\n\t\thorizontalSpacing: 20,\n\t\tverticalSpacing: 20,\n\t},\n): Node[] {\n\tconst { nodeWidth, nodeHeight, horizontalSpacing, verticalSpacing } = options;\n\n\t// Find root nodes (nodes with no incoming edges)\n\tconst rootNodes = nodes.filter(\n\t\t(node) =\u003e !edges.some((edge) =\u003e edge.target === node.id),\n\t);\n\n\t// Create a map of children for each node\n\tconst childrenMap = new Map\u003cstring, string[]\u003e();\n\tedges.forEach((edge) =\u003e {\n\t\tif (!childrenMap.has(edge.source)) {\n\t\t\tchildrenMap.set(edge.source, []);\n\t\t}\n\t\tchildrenMap.get(edge.source)?.push(edge.target);\n\t});\n\n\t// Position nodes recursively\n\tconst positionedNodes = [...nodes];\n\n\tconst positionNode = (\n\t\tnodeId: string,\n\t\tx: number,\n\t\ty: number,\n\t\tlevel: number,\n\t): void =\u003e {\n\t\tconst node = positionedNodes.find((n) =\u003e n.id === nodeId);\n\t\tif (node) {\n\t\t\tnode.position = { x, y };\n\t\t\tconst children = childrenMap.get(nodeId) || [];\n\t\t\tconst childrenWidth =\n\t\t\t\tchildren.length * (nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing) - horizontalSpacing;\n\t\t\tlet startX = x - childrenWidth / 2 + nodeWidth / 2;\n\n\t\t\tchildren.forEach((childId) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\tpositionNode(childId, startX, y + verticalSpacing, level + 1);\n\t\t\t\tstartX += nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing;\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\t};\n\n\t// Position the root nodes first\n\tconst totalWidth =\n\t\trootNodes.length * (nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing) - horizontalSpacing;\n\tlet startX = -totalWidth / 2;\n\n\trootNodes.forEach((rootNode) =\u003e {\n\t\tpositionNode(rootNode.id, startX, 0, 0);\n\t\tstartX += nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing;\n\t});\n\n\treturn positionedNodes;\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Creates a hierarchical tree layout for nodes\n */\nexport function organizeHierarchicalLayout(\n\tnodes: Node[],\n\tedges: any[],\n\toptions = {\n\t\tnodeWidth: 200,\n\t\tnodeHeight: 100,\n\t\thorizontalSpacing: 20,\n\t\tverticalSpacing: 20,\n\t},\n): Node[] {\n\tconst { nodeWidth, nodeHeight, horizontalSpacing, verticalSpacing } = options;\n\n\t// Find root nodes (nodes with no incoming edges)\n\tconst rootNodes = nodes.filter(\n\t\t(node) =\u003e !edges.some((edge) =\u003e edge.target === node.id),\n\t);\n\n\t// Create a map of children for each node\n\tconst childrenMap = new Map\u003cstring, string[]\u003e();\n\tedges.forEach((edge) =\u003e {\n\t\tif (!childrenMap.has(edge.source)) {\n\t\t\tchildrenMap.set(edge.source, []);\n\t\t}\n\t\tchildrenMap.get(edge.source)?.push(edge.target);\n\t});\n\n\t// Position nodes recursively\n\tconst positionedNodes = [...nodes];\n\n\tconst positionNode = (\n\t\tnodeId: string,\n\t\tx: number,\n\t\ty: number,\n\t\tlevel: number,\n\t): void =\u003e {\n\t\tconst node = positionedNodes.find((n) =\u003e n.id === nodeId);\n\t\tif (node) {\n\t\t\tnode.position = { x, y };\n\t\t\tconst children = childrenMap.get(nodeId) || [];\n\t\t\tconst childrenWidth =\n\t\t\t\tchildren.length * (nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing) - horizontalSpacing;\n\t\t\tlet startX = x - childrenWidth / 2 + nodeWidth / 2;\n\n\t\t\tchildren.forEach((childId) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\tpositionNode(childId, startX, y + verticalSpacing, level + 1);\n\t\t\t\tstartX += nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing;\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\t};\n\n\t// Position the root nodes first\n\tconst totalWidth =\n\t\trootNodes.length * (nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing) - horizontalSpacing;\n\tlet startX = -totalWidth / 2;\n\n\trootNodes.forEach((rootNode) =\u003e {\n\t\tpositionNode(rootNode.id, startX, 0, 0);\n\t\tstartX += nodeWidth + horizontalSpacing;\n\t});\n\n\treturn positionedNodes;\n}",
```

```json
        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport {useCallback, useEffect, useState} from 'react'\nimport {type MindMapNode, fetchNextMindmapRecords} from '../actions/fetch-next-mindmap-records'\n\n// Define constants outside component to avoid dependency issues\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 3\n\nexport function MindmapExplorer({initialTable = 'topics'}: {initialTable?: string}) {\n  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState\u003cMindMapNode[]\u003e([])\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [table, setTable] = useState(initialTable)\n  const [page, setPage] = useState(0)\n  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState\u003cstring | undefined\u003e(undefined)\n\n  const loadMoreNodes = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true)\n      setError(null)\n\n      // Call the server action directly from the client component\n      const result = await fetchNextMindmapRecords({\n        table,\n        size: PAGE_SIZE,\n        offset: page * PAGE_SIZE,\n        cursor,\n      })\n\n      // Update the nodes state with the returned nodes\n      setNodes((prev) =\u003e [...prev, ...result.nodes])\n\n      // Save the cursor for the next request\n      setCursor(result.meta.cursor)\n\n      // Increment page counter\n      setPage((prev) =\u003e prev + 1)\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Failed to fetch mindmap nodes:', err)\n      setError('Failed to load more nodes. The issue is in your graph container div. Looking at `src/features/mindmap/graph.tsx`, line 114:
```

```tsx
<div
  className='relative h-[100vh] w-[100vw] bg-black bg-repeat pointer-events-none z-0'
  style={{
    backgroundImage: "url('data:image/svg+xml...')",
  }}>
```

The `pointer-events-none` class is causing the problem. This CSS property makes the element ignore all mouse interactions including scrolling. 

Change the className to:

```tsx
className='relative h-[100vh] w-[100vw] bg-black bg-repeat z-0'
```

This will allow mouse interactions to work properly again while maintaining the same visual appearance.
